en: And when he directed himself toward Madyan,

ar: قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِى سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
en: he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."
And when he came to the water [i.e., well] of Madyan,

ar: وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ
en: he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks],
and he found aside from them two women holding back [their flocks].

ar: قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِى حَتَّىٰ يُصْدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُ ۖ
en: They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks];
and our father is an old man."
So he watered [their flocks] for them;
then he went back to the shade

ar: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
en: "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."
